title: Link the local-capacity principle to national capacity development
requirements:
- Point to structured national capacity programmes (competency, mentoring, communities of practice, retention)
- State that implementation capacity is budgeted as a standing resource, not a project output
- Add a proportionality statement: specialised technology may be used with an operating model and knowledge transfer
- Recognise the support ecosystem (ministry teams, local implementers, universities) that sustains national platforms
- Acknowledge evidence that technically sound deployments fail through implementation and adoption difficulty, and plan capacity accordingly
